verdict.rationale: The evidence shows HMRC runs a live, versioned REST API platform that returns a structured error contract (hmrc-probe-1), and that Making Tax Digital filing goes through compatible software (hmrc-supp-3). However, nothing in the pack shows a published OpenAPI spec, XML schema, or data dictionary. The developer hub exists, but its robots.txt blocked fetching, so no spec content was observed (hmrc-probe-2). A working API and a sanctioned software channel are adjacent capabilities, not a published machine-readable specification, so they earn no credit.
